prompt.description: What the orchestrator needs: seed a new study with arms, or refill one whose open arms fell below min_open_arms.

study_id.description: Study the researcher proposes arms for.

run_id.description: The researcher session's run id. Binds its artifact paths and is passed to hypothesis_bank.py --run-id.

tpu_version.description: TPU generation for hardware warnings: a canonical key of arm_microbench.TPU_HARDWARE_SPECS (v5e, v5p, v6e, v7x), passed to hypothesis_bank.py --tpu-version.

min_open_arms.description: Low watermark: the orchestrator calls the researcher again whenever open plus in_flight arms drop below it.

max_new_arms.description: Maximum number of arms admitted per researcher call (one invocation of hypothesis_bank.py)

profile_summary_path.description: XProf/HLO attribution summary from tpu-diagnostics, passed to hypothesis_bank.py --profile-summary-json.

completed_arms.description: Arm ids decided since the previous researcher call. They are the freshest evidence: read their results in the study state before proposing.

examples.prompt: Refill study modela-400b-ttft: open arms fell below min_open_arms.
